authentication.description: Optional API key (Authorization: Bearer abn_... or X-API-Key). Anonymous: 100 tool calls/day per IP.

tools.name: define_term
tools.title: Define a financial term
tools.description: Get the definition of a finance or economics term by its name or abbreviation (e.g. "ETF", "APR", "inflation", "put option"). Matching ignores case, accents and punctuation, accepts English names on any edition, and tolerates small typos. Returns the best entry with its full definition, aliases, category, related terms, translation status and canonical URL to cite, plus alternative candidates. If several entries share the exact name, returns ambiguous=true with candidates.

term.description: Term name or abbreviation to define.

lang.description: Language code of the dictionary edition (e.g. en, es, de, fr, ja, zh-CN). Use list_languages for names.

tools.name: search_terms
tools.title: Search the dictionary
tools.description: Search Abinomics term names, aliases and abbreviations (and, as a last resort, definition text). Use for partial, exploratory or uncertain queries. Returns ranked matches with slug, name, short definition, category and URL. Use get_term with a slug for the full entry.

lang.description: Language code of the dictionary edition (e.g. en, es, de, fr, ja, zh-CN). Use list_languages for names.

tools.name: get_term
tools.title: Get a term by slug
tools.description: Fetch one dictionary entry by its slug (the stable id used in URLs, e.g. "exchange-traded-fund"). Slugs are the same in every language edition.

lang.description: Language code of the dictionary edition (e.g. en, es, de, fr, ja, zh-CN). Use list_languages for names.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List dictionary categories (economics, finance, politics; older keys such as crypto or markets are aliases of finance) with localized labels and term counts.

lang.description: Language code of the dictionary edition (e.g. en, es, de, fr, ja, zh-CN). Use list_languages for names.

tools.name: browse_category
tools.title: Browse a category
tools.description: List terms in one category (use list_categories for keys), alphabetically with short definitions. Paginate with offset.

category.description: Category key: economics, finance or politics (older keys like "crypto" still work as aliases).

lang.description: Language code of the dictionary edition (e.g. en, es, de, fr, ja, zh-CN). Use list_languages for names.

tools.name: list_languages
tools.title: List languages
tools.description: List the 36 language editions with codes, names, site URLs and translation coverage.

tools.name: random_term
tools.title: Random term
tools.description: Return a random dictionary entry, e.g. for a "term of the day" or quiz.

lang.description: Language code of the dictionary edition (e.g. en, es, de, fr, ja, zh-CN). Use list_languages for names.

tools.name: define_genomics_term
tools.title: Define a genetics or genomics term
tools.description: Get the definition of a genetics, genomics or molecular biology term by name or abbreviation (e.g. "allele", "PCR", "codon", "Hardy-Weinberg law"). Matching ignores case, accents and punctuation, accepts English names on any edition, and tolerates small typos. Returns the best entry with its full definition, category, related terms, translation status and canonical URL to cite, plus alternative candidates. Educational reference, not medical advice.

term.description: Term name or abbreviation to define.

lang.description: Language code of the dictionary edition (e.g. en, es, de, fr, ja, zh-CN). Use list_languages for names.

annotations.title: Define a genetics or genomics term

tools.name: search_genomics
tools.title: Search the genomics dictionary
tools.description: Search genomics/genetics term names and abbreviations (and, as a last resort, definition text). Use for partial or exploratory queries. Returns ranked matches with slug, name, short definition, category and URL; use get_genomics_term with a slug for the full entry. Optional category filter.

lang.description: Language code of the dictionary edition (e.g. en, es, de, fr, ja, zh-CN). Use list_languages for names.

category.description: Optional genomics category key (see list_genomics_categories), e.g. "molecular-biology".

tools.name: get_genomics_term
tools.title: Get a genomics term by slug
tools.description: Fetch one genomics dictionary entry by its slug (stable id used in /genomics/{slug}/ URLs, e.g. "allele", "messenger-rna"). Slugs are the same in every language edition.

lang.description: Language code of the dictionary edition (e.g. en, es, de, fr, ja, zh-CN). Use list_languages for names.

annotations.title: Get a genomics term by slug

tools.name: list_genomics_categories
tools.title: List genomics categories
tools.description: List genomics dictionary categories (molecular biology, genomics & sequencing, classical genetics, cytogenetics, population genetics, medical genetics, biotechnology, model organisms, ...) with labels and term counts.

lang.description: Language code of the dictionary edition (e.g. en, es, de, fr, ja, zh-CN). Use list_languages for names.

tools.name: browse_genomics_category
tools.title: Browse a genomics category
tools.description: List genomics terms in one category (use list_genomics_categories for keys), alphabetically with short definitions. Paginate with offset.

lang.description: Language code of the dictionary edition (e.g. en, es, de, fr, ja, zh-CN). Use list_languages for names.

tools.name: random_genomics_term
tools.title: Random genomics term
tools.description: Return a random genomics dictionary entry, optionally within one category, e.g. for a quiz or "term of the day".

lang.description: Language code of the dictionary edition (e.g. en, es, de, fr, ja, zh-CN). Use list_languages for names.

category.description: Optional genomics category key (see list_genomics_categories), e.g. "molecular-biology".
